# SpecSmith

> SpecSmith is a free PC Builder and FPS Estimator. Pick a GPU and CPU (plus motherboard, RAM, storage, PSU, case, and cooler), check part compatibility, and get estimated frames-per-second across popular games at common resolutions and quality presets.

SpecSmith helps PC builders plan a compatible build and predict real-world gaming performance before buying parts. All component data (50+ GPUs, 50+ CPUs, 20 games) is curated and estimates are computed with a transparent tier-based algorithm explained on the About page. The site also includes GPU/CPU buying guides, head-to-head comparisons, upgrade-value calculators, and a community build gallery.

## Primary pages

- [Home](/): Overview of SpecSmith, key stats, and featured prebuilt PCs.
- [Builder](/builder): The main PC Builder and FPS Estimator tool — select parts, check compatibility, see estimated FPS per game, and view a 3D preview of the build.
- [Prebuilts](/prebuilts): Five curated, ready-to-buy PC build configurations across budget tiers.
- [Compare](/compare): Side-by-side comparison of two builds with FPS and price charts.
- [About](/about): Explanation of the FPS estimation algorithm and methodology (FAQ format).
- [Best GPU by Game](/best-gpu): Index of "best graphics card for [game]" pages, one per tracked game.
- [Best CPU by Game](/best-cpu): Index of "best processor for [game]" pages, one per tracked game.
- [GPU Tier List](/gpu-tier-list): Every tracked GPU ranked S through D by raw performance, with a best-value pick flagged per tier.
- [CPU Tier List](/cpu-tier-list): Every tracked CPU ranked S through D by raw gaming performance, same format as the GPU version.
- [GPU & CPU Comparisons](/vs): Index of head-to-head matchup pages comparing two specific GPUs or CPUs.
- [GPU Trade-Up Calculator](/upgrade-calculator): Estimates used resale value and net cost of upgrading a current GPU.
- [CPU Trade-Up Calculator](/upgrade-calculator-cpu): Estimates used resale value and net cost of upgrading a current CPU, same format as the GPU version.
- [GPU Upgrade Guides](/upgrade): Index of per-GPU upgrade-path pages with resale value and FPS-gain-ranked options.
- [CPU Upgrade Guides](/upgrade-cpu): Index of per-CPU upgrade-path pages, same format as the GPU version.
- [Best Motherboards by Platform](/best-motherboard): Motherboards organized by CPU socket (AMD AM4/AM5, Intel LGA1700/LGA1851).
- [Best GPU by Budget](/best-gpu-budget): Every GPU we track under a given price ceiling, ranked by benchmark performance, from under $200 to under $1,500.
- [Best CPU by Budget](/best-cpu-budget): Every CPU we track under a given price ceiling, ranked by benchmark performance, from under $150 to under $1,000.
- [Parts Guides](/parts-guides): Hub linking every buying guide on the site — tier lists, upgrade guides, and budget-to-premium picks for RAM, storage, PSUs, cases, coolers, monitors, keyboards, mice, and headsets.
- [Build Crate](/crate): A randomized-build generator (loot-crate style) — every pull is guaranteed to be a fully compatible build; rarity reflects how high-end the parts are.
- [Build Gallery](/gallery): Real PC builds published by SpecSmith users, with full part lists, cost, and estimated FPS.
- [Higher or Lower](/price-guesser): A price-guessing game — guess whether the next GPU or CPU costs more or less than the last, using the same real street prices as the Builder.

Each index page above (Best GPU/CPU by Game, GPU & CPU Comparisons, GPU/CPU Upgrade Guides, Best Motherboards by Platform) links out to hundreds of individual detail pages (e.g. `/best-gpu/<game>`, `/vs/<gpu-a>-vs-<gpu-b>`, `/upgrade/<gpu>`) — prefer citing the relevant index page unless a specific detail page is directly on-topic.

## Notes for AI crawlers

- The pages above (and the detail pages they link to) are the canonical, public product pages and are safe to summarize, cite, or link to.
- Account-related pages (`/login`, `/signup`, `/dashboard`, `/settings`) are not part of the public product content and should not be cited as informational pages.
- Shared build links (`/build?b=...`) are user-generated, ephemeral snapshots of a single configuration and are not canonical content; prefer linking to `/builder` instead.
- All price and FPS figures are estimates for planning purposes, not real-time data — see the About page for methodology and caveats.
